summary: MCQ pool two-stage verification fix validated. 8/8 pytest cases passed. Verified: (a) /api/admin/mcq-stats founder-only endpoint returns pool + verifier stats, (b) non-founder gets 403, (c) mcq_pool grows over ~90-120s via background worker, (d) POST /api/oa/start on core-default reaches generation_status=ready with all sections populated, (e) CRITICAL — every served MCQ with a non-empty explanation was independently re-checked with a fresh Sonnet call: the explanation-derived index matches the stored correct_index in 100% of concrete picks (no regressions), (f) /api/oa/{attempt_id}/review answer_key entries are internally consistent.

minor.issue: Litellm/pydantic serializer warnings emitted during Sonnet calls (harmless): 'PydanticSerializationUnexpectedValue' + 'coroutine close_litellm_async_clients was never awaited'. Cosmetic, does not affect correctness.

critical_code_review_comments: mcq_pool._verify_question correctly runs the two Sonnet checks in parallel via asyncio.create_task, and overrides q['correct_index'] in-place when exp_idx==v_idx!=claimed. However, when exp_idx is None (explanation gave -1 or was missing) the code falls back to `v_idx == claimed`, which reintroduces the original failure mode for questions whose generator emitted a nonsense/empty explanation but a still-wrong correct_index. Consider making explanation mandatory (reject if empty) so the two-stage gate always fires.

MAX_VERIFY_RETRIES + regeneration loop in _generate_and_pool_one only overwrites q on retry but never re-invokes the explanation check with the NEW single-question payload — that path does go through _verify_question again, so behavior is correct; noted for readability only.

server.py review endpoint (line ~1183-1234) reads `correct_index` and `explanation` straight from the stored attempt document. Historical attempts created before this fix may still expose the bug; recommendation (out of scope): backfill script that re-runs _verify_question over existing attempt questions and either fixes correct_index or marks the section as 'stale'.
TestPoolGrowth is time-bounded (120s). On a very rate-limited LLM key the pool may not grow enough; the test uses a lenient assertion (>= max(c0+1, 3)) but is inherently a soft check.

answer_key in /review already omits sections with type=coding/essay — good. Consider surfacing explanation_pick / overridden_from metadata (currently only logged) in mcq_pool_stats so founders can see how many stored questions were corrected by the fix.

If you change the verifier logic, run this test first.
rca of the issue: Original bug: mcq_pool.py trusted the generator's claimed correct_index if a single independent Sonnet verifier agreed. Failure mode: generator emitted an explanation arguing for option B but set correct_index=C; if the independent verifier (blind to the explanation) also happened to pick C, the mismatch between the user-visible explanation and the marked-correct answer went undetected. Fix: added _explanation_derived_index (Sonnet reads the explanation and picks which option it argues for) and made the pool-gate require BOTH signals to agree. When they agree with each other but disagree with the generator's claim, the stored correct_index is mutated to the consensus. When they disagree with each other, the question is discarded. Validated end-to-end: all served MCQs on a live core-default attempt passed a fresh Sonnet consistency check.
